subject.title: feat(queue): persist followup queues across gateway restarts

question: Should OpenClaw make queued follow-up messages durable and automatically resume them after a gateway restart, accepting the resulting persistent replay semantics for existing installations?
rationale: The implementation appears to address a real loss mode, but persisting and later replaying session-scoped messages changes the product contract beyond a mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Approve durable follow-up recovery
options.body: Accept shared-SQLite persistence and startup recovery as the supported contract, subject to normal green checks and owner review.

options.title: Limit recovery behavior
options.body: Keep the persistence groundwork but narrow or defer automatic restart delivery until a different replay/ordering contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve durable follow-up recovery
recommendation.body: Accept shared-SQLite persistence and startup recovery as the supported contract, subject to normal green checks and owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the central queue-state surface affected by the new persistence contract.
